title: release: 17.0.0-rc.4 published from a10cbc77 but the version commit never landed on main — 2026-08-03 shape repeated; merge it back before ANY further release action
body:
## Facts (all measured 2026-08-07 ~05:30Z)

- **The publish is real**: 69 tags `*@17.0.0-rc.4` (138 ls-remote lines incl. peeled), ALL pointing at one commit `a10cbc77a1e83a382d4a190879b39d588435a04d` — `chore: version packages (rc)`, github-actions[bot], **2026-08-07 04:17:39Z**. npm confirms: `npm view @objectstack/spec@17.0.0-rc.4 version` → `17.0.0-rc.4`; `dist-tags.rc` → `17.0.0-rc.4`.
- **Cut from** `36fc938` (#6150) — i.e. it contains #6149's version reconciliation and everything merged up to 04:1xZ (incl. #6078 / #6107 / #6142), so the computed rc.4 numbers are correct. Commits after 36fc938 (#6153, #6156, #5827, #6158, #6154, #6166…) ride the next rc.
- **Not an ancestor of main**: absent from the last 60 main commits; merge-base with main is its parent 36fc938. Same failure shape as 2026-08-03 (#6135, rc.3 / `c6a52d3`), one version later.
- **What the orphaned commit carries**: 153 files, +33604/−79 — the rc.4 `package.json` bumps, the **compiled CHANGELOGs**, and the `.changeset/pre.json` bookkeeping. Zero `.changeset/*.md` deletions (prerelease mode consumes via `pre.json`, not file deletion).
- **The bypass also skipped the release gates**: `.objectui-sha` in the published tree is `f995a452` — the stale pin. The 7 releasing objectui changesets (#6159) are absent from rc.4's record; `check:objectui-pin-fresh` (required on #4935) never ran because the lane didn't go through #4935. That is the v16 loss shape recurring — second occurrence evidence for the root-cause issue.

## Why this must be fixed before anything else in the release lane

main's `package.json` still say `17.0.0-rc.3`, so every regeneration of `changeset-release/main` computes **rc.4 again** — a version npm now already has. The branch has in fact regenerated after the publish (head `a1e65f22` ≠ `a10cbc77`), so **⚠️ merging #4935 as it stands is the collision trap, not the fix**. Do not merge #4935 and do not run the publish lane again until this issue closes.

## Remedy (measured, clean)

`git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main a10cbc77` → **exit 0, no conflicts**. So:

1. Push the published commit as a branch: `git push origin a10cbc77a1e83a382d4a190879b39d588435a04d:refs/heads/release/rc4-merge-back`
2. Open a PR (base `main`), label `skip-changeset` (release bookkeeping; `.changeset/**` must not be touched beyond what the commit itself carries), land it through the merge queue.
3. After it lands, `changeset-release/main` regenerates from rc.4 state → #4935 becomes the **rc.5** PR, and the dry-run check is simply "does #4935 now propose rc.5?".

Ordering vs #6159 (console bump): independent — its changeset is a new file, no conflict either way; it now targets rc.5 (see note there).

## Related

#6135 / #6149 (rc.3 instance + field-level reconciliation) · root-cause issue: see the companion issue filed together with this one · #6159 (missed window) · #3340 (the gate the bypass skipped) · #4935
